report_name: Ransomware attack hits Texas water treatment facility via vendor

identities.name: Texas Water Treatment Facility
identities.description: An unnamed water treatment facility in Texas that was the victim of a ransomware attack originating from a compromised third-party vendor in September 2026.

indicators.name: Suspicious Network Traffic from IT to OT Segment
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Network Traffic from IT to OT Segment
id: 2b8a1b9e-7c4d-4f8a-b9e8-1d2c3b4a5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual network traffic flowing from the corporate IT network to the Operational Technology (OT) network. Such traffic, if not explicitly allowed by policy, can indicate lateral movement from a compromised IT environment into sensitive industrial control systems.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-13
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/water-and-wastewater-systems-sector
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    SourceIp|cidr:
      - '192.168.0.0/16' # Placeholder for IT network range
      - '172.16.0.0/12'  # Placeholder for IT network range
    DestinationIp|cidr:
      - '10.0.0.0/8'       # Placeholder for OT network range
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic from common IT network address spaces to OT network address spaces, which could indicate unauthorized lateral movement. This is based on hunting hints provided in the article.

indicators.name: Anomalous Third-Party Remote Access Login
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Third-Party Remote Access Login
id: 9e8f7d6c-5b4a-4c3d-b2a1-e9f8d7c6b5a4
status: experimental
description: Detects successful remote access logins from third-party vendor accounts originating from non-corporate IP space or at unusual hours. This could indicate compromised vendor credentials being used for initial access.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-13
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/water-and-wastewater-systems-sector
level: medium
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: vpn
detection:
  selection:
    user_name|contains: # Adjust field and value for specific vendor naming conventions
      - '_vendor'
      - '3rdparty_'
    action: 'login'
    status: 'success'
  filter:
    source_ip|cidr:
      - '203.0.113.0/24' # Placeholder for expected vendor IP ranges
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects successful remote access logins from accounts associated with third-party vendors, which should be correlated with geolocation and time-of-day to identify potential credential compromise, as suggested by the article's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Ransomware File Artifact Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Artifact Creation
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with common ransomware extensions or ransom note filenames. This is a strong indicator of an active ransomware infection.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-13
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/water-and-wastewater-systems-sector
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.locked'
      - '.crypted'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\README.txt'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with common ransomware-related extensions or names, based on the hunting hints provided for identifying a ransomware attack.
